items.claim: Inhibin is high and FSH is low because Sertoli cells are overactive.
items.correction: In adult Klinefelter syndrome, Sertoli cell dysfunction causes low inhibin B and elevated FSH. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279145/)

items.claim: Invasive lobular carcinoma of the breast is defined by overexpression of E-cadherin, which makes its cells grow in single-file lines.
items.correction: Classic invasive lobular carcinoma typically loses E-cadherin expression; reduced cell adhesion produces the single-file pattern. [Review](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7359988/)

items.claim: A complete hydatidiform mole is triploid (69,XXY) and usually contains fetal parts.
items.correction: A complete mole is usually androgenetic diploid (46,XX or 46,XY) and lacks fetal parts. Triploidy with possible fetal tissue describes a partial mole. [NCBI Bookshelf](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK470267/)

items.claim: Hypocalcemia after thyroidectomy is caused by injury to the recurrent laryngeal nerve.
items.correction: Post-thyroidectomy hypocalcemia results from parathyroid injury, removal, or loss of blood supply; recurrent laryngeal nerve injury causes voice changes. [JAMA Surgery](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamasurgery/fullarticle/401446)

items.claim: In central diabetes insipidus, urine concentrates during water deprivation and does not respond to desmopressin.
items.correction: In central diabetes insipidus, urine concentrates poorly during water deprivation and its osmolality rises after desmopressin. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/books/NBK537591/)

items.claim: Pheochromocytoma should be treated with a beta-blocker first and an alpha-blocker second.
items.correction: Begin alpha blockade first; add beta blockade afterward if needed for tachycardia. Beta blockade first can precipitate hypertensive crisis through unopposed alpha stimulation. [Endocrine Society guideline](https://doi.org/10.1210/jc.2014-1498)
